title: Volume keys for active application
line: New shortcuts raise, lower or mute the volume of the app in the focused window, with an OSD showing that app.
explanation: The Audio Volume shortcuts only act on the output device (volume, 1% steps, mute) or the microphone, and plasma-workspace's "Media volume" shortcuts follow the last MPRIS player, not the focused window. There was no way to change one application's volume without opening the applet. The audio shortcuts kded module now tracks windows with LibTaskManager and offers three unbound shortcuts (Increase/Decrease Volume of Active Application, Mute Active Application) that act on the playback streams whose process is the focused window's process or one of its children (or whose Flatpak app id matches), and show the app's name and icon in the OSD.

commits.message:
kded: add shortcuts to change the volume of the active application

Volume shortcuts could only change the output device, so adjusting one
application meant opening the applet. Add unbound shortcuts that raise,
lower or mute the streams of the focused window and its child processes.

BUG: 450762

media.caption: Shortcuts > Audio Volume before: only device and microphone actions
Shortcuts > Audio Volume after: Decrease/Increase Volume of Active Application and Mute Active Application, unbound by default
Before: with a player window focused, Volume Down only changes the master volume (and Ctrl+Volume Down does nothing)
After: Ctrl+Volume Down bound to the new action lowers only the focused player's stream; OSD shows the app (Konsole running paplay), master untouched
Binding Ctrl+Volume Down to Decrease Volume of Active Application in the Shortcuts page
Mute Active Application on the other player: "Konsole Muted", the first player keeps playing
